title: Material Blend 3-Mix Trio #24 (대각 띠·매끈 / 세로 띠·물결 / 동심원·물결 | 나비날개비늘+왁스+공작눈무늬 / 스테인드글라스+UV네온+공작눈무늬 / 석재+스테인드글라스+왁스)

The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it., no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme amazon bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
